title: Product Plan
description: Main's bounded build packet for Coder. allowed_paths is a whitelist; non_goals is a don't-list.

allowed_paths.description: STRICT whitelist of paths Coder may edit

planned_files.description: Specific files Coder will create or modify (subset of allowed_paths)

non_goals.description: Explicit don't-list — Coder MUST NOT do these even if tempting

verification_commands.description: Shell commands QA will re-run to verify the build

acceptance_checks.description: Human-readable conditions that must be true after build

protected_surface_notes.description: Notes on protected surfaces (auth, payments, schemas)

parent_criteria_refs.description: Decomposition trace (§9 LOW). Criterion ids this child plan owns from a parent work-breakdown split. ABSENT for a normally-authored plan; PRESENT only on a decomposition child, where decompose_check D9 requires it non-empty and exactly equal to the child's owned coverage ids.
